## Accepted discriminant-localized partial result, attempt 1/5

AIM Problem 4.3, Categorified Hecke algebras, link homology, and Hilbert schemes; corpus 20000088 / AIM-ALGEBRAIC_GEOMETRY-0088, rank 1266. In characteristic zero, for every n≥3 at δ=0, the proof constructs actual strong monoidal dg flattening after homogeneous discriminant localization. It identifies the standard object and its χ,μ operators with (Sⁿ,diag(xᵢ),0) in the homotopy category, preserving the indexed filtration and specified internal/cohomological degrees. This is the tautological X,Y pair on the regular-semisimple open of the semi-nilpotent flag-Hilbert slice.

The full authored proof preserves the literal MMV rotation conventions; affine-dot cone/unit/counit maps; explicit positive/inverse contractions and α⁻¹ shift normalization; coherent H⁰ strictification and termwise dg extension; graded spectral splitting; and the exact GNR Koszul and derived-projectivization tower calculations. The written mathematical audit and acceptance report accompany it.

This excludes the collision divisor, unlocalized flattening, global GNR comparison, a prescribed source cyclic arrow and half-braiding compatibility. It does not settle the original global problem or any neighboring center-generation target. Novelty confidence is low; the component tools are standard, and the cited primary inputs receive explicit credit.

## Distribution and review limits

Exactly seven authored proof/audit/acceptance/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20000088/`. All mathematical statements, arguments, examples and scope qualifications are retained. Editorial changes reconcile the completed audit, remove private workflow/version provenance and unavailable-checker commentary, and bind the audit and acceptance to the distributed files. Excluded computational outputs are not recast as prose.

Programs, computational outputs and receipts, fixtures, datasets, copied third-party source bodies, source-derived images and private coordination material are excluded. This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition claims no historical novelty, exhaustive current-openness, external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Source retrieval and inspection metadata record historical observations; edition preparation claims no fresh scholarly retrieval, source-file rehash, source inspection or literature search.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset partial attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
